gate-fail order GL > GT > GTP; GTI is not computed when no test is testable (before 11.t a GTI failure would have labelled the tests cadence); p = 1 either way

cb13_t.fill: print-anchored: lift (a0 <= P_min, P_max <= a0 + s0) -> maker sold at P_min; hit (b0 - s0 <= P_min, P_max <= b0) -> maker bought at P_max; inside spread: no fill; else inconsistent

hold.cb3_hold: q0275 waits for CB3's freeze commit or its ledger stop record

labels.T2: mid-marked maker net, upper bound (free exit), L1

cb13_t.tau: earliest venue time of the transaction's prints (conservative for the touch)
cb13_t.units: every touch-consistent transaction; one-per-side-per-pass, all-prints, stale-touch and size-weighted variants are reported

T.disclosure: the screen records but does not cross-check the census rules_sha256 against the current T hash; that check is part of the post-run audit

audit.second_fail: T1 and T2 not testable (labeller), counted

cb13_label.inputs: title, slug, ctx_category, ctx_fee_type (static attributes) and the touch capture sidecar fee_type, fee_category, series_slugs; no price, mark or outcome

added: PUBLIC_R1_RE (macro releases, post counts, box office, chart ranks)

klines.range: min(T0) - 30 d over primary events to 2026-09

labels.R2: modelled-cost economic check on the sealed window (L2)
labels.rep: out-of-time replication on a sealed later window (L2)

members.creation_anchored: excluded and counted before the flags (section 11.z B): description matches '(?i)\\bfrom\\s+the\\s+creation\\s+of\\s+this\\s+market\\b'; never rescued by relaxing the High/Low rule
members.flags: per member (section 11.z A): a member failing a frozen flag is dropped and counted; an event is dropped for flags only if no member passes
members.gr_flag_share: binding over non-anchored members; also reported over all parsed members (creation-anchored included) and the creation-anchored share

model.sigma: 30 d of usable 5-minute log returns x sqrt(105120); >= 90% of bars

cb13_r.primary: weekly template only (window <= 8 d); monthly, yearly and by are census-only (no prices)

r1.attribution: gap coefficient >= 0.30 and >= half of beta
r1.stale_price_joint: q_touch coefficient >= half of solo, one-sided p < 0.05

cb13_r.units: daily 00:00Z checkpoints from max(T0, listing + 1 h) to T - 1 h; undecided on usable klines; p in [0.03, 0.97]; p_t age <= 6 h, p_reg age <= 24 h before t - 6 h
cb13_r.window: 12:00 AM ET on the first title date to 11:59 PM ET on the last; T = 00:00 ET of the next day (exclusive); ET via America/New_York (DST)
